_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Engineering Judgement Record (EJR)
summary: The Engineering Judgement Record (EJR) consolidates the engineering analyses and reasoning supporting deviations to tolerances, limits, and other parameters documented in a depot level Technical Repair Standard (TRS).
use_relationship:
The Engineering Judgement Record (EJR) sets forth and consolidates into one document, the engineering analyses and reasoning in support of all deviations to tolerances, limits, and other parameters documented in a depot level Technical Repair Standard (TRS). The EJR is applicable to each weapon system, equipment, component, assembly, or subassembly for which a TRS is prepared. The EJR should accompany the submission of the TRS (MIL-DTL-24784/7), but will not form a part of the TRS. Development of TRSs are in accordance with Technical Manual Contract Requirements (TMCRs) based on the requirements of MIL-DTL-24784/7.

This DID contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Engineering Judgement Record (EJR) shall be presented in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The EJR shall contain a cover sheet identifying the configuration item by code, mark, mod, effectivity, and applicable TRS(s).

preparation_instructions.title: The EJR shall contain the following sections

children.title: Designated Overhaul Activities (DOAs).
children.content: The DOAs section shall identify the TRS(s) applicable and the specific rationale/justification required in support of each TRS cited.

children.title: Specialized Overhaul Activities (SOAs).
children.content: The SOAs section shall identify the applicable TRS and shall contain the rationale/justification required in support of each TRS cited.

children.title: Designated Repair Activities (DRAs).
children.content: The DRAs section shall identify the applicable TRS and shall contain the specific rationale/justification required in support of each TRS cited.

children.title: Tender Repair (TR).
children.content: The TR section shall identify the applicable TRS and shall contain the specific rationale/justification required in support of each TRS cited.
